name: Kiba Hata to Kuro Tsubasa to Shirogane no Hane
original_name: 牙旗と黒翼と白銀の羽
source:
"I will lead you to the end... So, in the end, let it be your hands that bring it about..."

Chased by a grotesque being and on the verge of death, I was saved by a girl who seemed to be lost, accompanied by a deep blue lion.

She said she came to have her wish granted... That’s what she said.
She wished for me to kill her... That’s what she asked.

On a night when the moon forms a new circle... my world will face a transformation...

[Translated From Website]
